Overview

The economics of Applied AI & GenAI for Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into MES layers without inventing a shadow estate. What makes Manufacturing & Industrial different is not the math; it is the operating context: ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 quality governs the data, OEE uplift governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
